identity.name: Aether Labs
identity.mission: To provide an AI chat experience that feels like interacting with a higher intelligence—clean, distraction-free, and aesthetically profound.

weights.headings: 600 (SemiBold) or 500 (Medium) - Avoid 700+ for a cleaner look

containers.sidebar: hidden md:flex flex-col w-[280px] border-r border-white/5 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xl

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(99,102,241,0.3)] transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-foreground hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm transition-all duration-200 rounded-full px-6 py-2
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-white/5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors rounded-md px-3 py-2

inputs.chat_input: bg-white/5 border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-base shadow-inner placeholder:text-white/20 transition-all duration-300

cards.glass: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl shadow-xl

chat_bubbles.user: bg-primary text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-5 py-3 max-w-[85%] self-end shadow-lg shadow-primary/10
chat_bubbles.ai: bg-white/5 border border-white/5 text-foreground rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm px-5 py-3 max-w-[85%] self-start backdrop-blur-sm

assets.icons: Use lucide-react for all UI icons. Use simple, thin strokes (stroke-width={1.5}).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements (ring-2 ring-primary/50).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (obsidian, primary indigo) and fonts.
2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
3. LAYOUT: Implement the 'Dashboard Grid' layout. Sidebar on left (collapsible on mobile), Chat area on right.
4. CHAT UI: The chat area should have a sticky bottom input. The messages list should scroll behind it.
5. MARKDOWN: Use 'react-markdown' with 'remark-gfm' for rendering AI responses. Style the code blocks with a dark theme (e.g., dracula or atom-dark).
6. SIDEBAR: The sidebar should list 'Recent Chats'. Use a glassmorphic effect for the sidebar background.
7. EMPTY STATE: When no chat is selected, show a welcoming 'Hero' section in the center with the Aether logo and suggested prompts.
8. TRACING BEAM: If possible, add a subtle glowing border effect to the active chat input.
9. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all buttons (e.g., 'send-button', 'new-chat-button') and inputs.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'Inter' everywhere. Use 'Outfit' for headings to give it character.
Do not use pure black (#000000). Use #050505 or #0A0A0A for depth.
Add 'backdrop-blur' to sticky headers and floating elements.
Use 'gap-4' or 'gap-6' for comfortable spacing in lists.
Ensure the 'Copy Code' button in code blocks is visible and accessible.
